title: Bagh-Chal Deluxe: Tiger and Goat
bannerAlt: Bagh-Chal Deluxe: Tiger and Goat
description: Nepal’s traditional tiger and goat game in a complete Deluxe edition: a carved three-dimensional board, 44 puzzles in a campaign, 14 hands-on lessons, five computer levels or a friend, a daily challenge, and Auto Play to watch and learn. Fills the whole screen in portrait and landscape. No ads, works offline. Free preview, then a one-time unlock.

title: Golden Sling Deluxe
bannerAlt: Golden Sling Deluxe: pull, aim, release, guard the harvest
description: A paper-cut diorama of four seasons: 32 fields, four guardian bosses, a carved slingshot and birds raiding the crop. Pull back, aim and release to scare them off before the harvest is gone, with wind, combos and a Harvest Journal to fill. Works in portrait and landscape, with a Rules page and Auto Play to watch and learn. Free, no ads, works offline.

title: Word Game Deluxe
bannerAlt: Word Game Deluxe: a bridge of opposites, a net for synonyms
description: A word adventure for every age, from the alphabet read aloud to professional vocabulary. Look any word up in a built-in dictionary and thesaurus that works offline, build a bridge of opposites and cast a net for synonyms across 30 levels each, then keep going with more than seventy puzzles including analogies, your own word lists, a Word Garden that grows as you learn, graded reading, a Speech Lab and a Start Here path for beginners. Choose an age group and a learning level and the words follow. Fills the screen in portrait and landscape, with Auto Play to watch and learn. No ads, no account, works offline. Free preview, then a one-time unlock.

title: Solitaire Deluxe
bannerAlt: Solitaire Deluxe: The most comfortable way to play solitaire
description: Six solitaire games in real 3D: Klondike, Spider, FreeCell, Pyramid, TriPeaks and Golf, with winnable deals, hints that explain themselves, unlimited undo, daily deals and big-print, left-handed and one-hand comfort settings.

title: Carrom Deluxe
bannerAlt: Carrom Deluxe: Premium 3D carrom with real physics
description: A real-time 3D carrom board with a physics engine written from scratch: powder friction, rebounds and spin. Full international rules, five computer levels plus Adaptive, twenty lessons, a ten stage campaign, daily challenge, doubles and pass and play, replay, and boards, powders, coins and strikers to unlock. Offline, no ads.

title: Sudoku Deluxe
bannerAlt: Sudoku Deluxe: Hand-crafted Sudoku in 3D, with a coach that teaches
description: Seven Sudoku variants on an engraved 3D board: a library of over 1,500 puzzles, each proven to have one solution and graded by the techniques it needs. A coach explains the next logical step, a Learn path teaches every technique from Full House to forcing chains, and Watch and Learn plays whole puzzles for you.

title: Dominoes Deluxe
bannerAlt: Dominoes Deluxe: Seven classic domino games on one beautiful 3D table
description: Cuban Partners, Doble Nueve, Block, Draw, All Fives, Mexican Train and Chicken Foot, each with its own rules page, against computer opponents at five levels plus Adaptive that remember every tile and read every pass. Ivory, ebony or rosewood tiles on felt, walnut or marble, hints with reasons, a live coach, ten lessons, Watch & Learn, a daily challenge and statistics. Works offline, no ads.

title: Go Deluxe
bannerAlt: Go Deluxe: Learn and play Go on a lit 3D board
description: A teaching-first Go with a 3D kaya board, ten computer levels, twelve lessons, over 150 life-and-death problems, a daily problem and game review. No ads.

title: Chess Deluxe
bannerAlt: Chess Deluxe: Beautiful 3D chess that teaches you to win
description: A real-time 3D chess board with carved pieces, ten computer levels, a coach that explains your mistakes, 36 lessons, hundreds of rated puzzles, a daily puzzle and a full game review. Offline, no ads.

title: Ludo Deluxe
bannerAlt: Ludo Deluxe: Calm, beautiful Ludo, Pachisi and Royal Cross
description: Roll real dice out of a leather cup onto a lit 3D board and race glossy tokens around the cross. Three classic games in one app (Ludo, Pachisi with cowrie shells and Royal Cross with two dice), computer players with four levels and five personalities, nine lessons, Watch & Learn, a Cup, a League season, a Daily Challenge and 28 trophies. Works offline, no ads.

title: Cricket Chase Deluxe
bannerAlt: Cricket Chase Deluxe: Floodlit chases with real ball physics
description: A premium night cricket game: a 60-situation Chase Table, batting and bowling, field setting, a daily chase, an eight-team cup, super overs, lessons and a coach, in a real-time 3D stadium with swing, spin, seam and wind.

title: Mahjong Deluxe
bannerAlt: Mahjong Deluxe: Riichi and Hong Kong mahjong, played like a pro
description: A full four-player mahjong table in real-time 3D: engraved tiles, a wall that builds in front of you, dice and a dealer compass. Choose Riichi (Japanese) or Hong Kong rules, play four computer levels from Beginner to Master, and learn with a coach that grades every discard and explains shape, waits and scoring in plain words. Lessons, a daily hand, unlimited practice puzzles, a scoring calculator, a fan and yaku reference, replays and Watch and Learn. Score only, no ads, works offline.

title: Backgammon Deluxe
bannerAlt: Backgammon Deluxe: Dice, strategy and nerve
description: A premium 3D backgammon table with the doubling cube, match play and the Turkish and Greek table games Tavla, Portes, Plakoto and Fevga. A strong computer opponent, a coach, lessons, puzzles and a World Tour.

title: Arcforge Mancala Deluxe
bannerAlt: Arcforge Mancala Deluxe: Oware and Kalah on a real 3D board
description: A premium 3D mancala with physical seeds on a carved wooden board, Oware and Kalah rule sets, a strong computer opponent, lessons, a puzzle campaign, a daily challenge, game review and heritage chapters.

title: Arcforge Minesweeper Deluxe
bannerAlt: Arcforge Minesweeper Deluxe: Tactile 3D tiles. Logic that explains itself
description: A premium 3D minesweeper with boards that never need a guess, a coach that explains every deduction, five grids (square, hexagon, triangle, octagon and wrap-around), a 61-puzzle Deduction Academy, a daily challenge, records, trophies and six themes.

title: Arcforge Mini Golf Deluxe
bannerAlt: Arcforge Mini Golf Deluxe: Premium 3D mini golf: 54 holes, portals, windmills and ghosts
description: Slingshot-putt round 54 holes on six themed courses in a real-time 3D world. Slopes, ramps, sand, ice, water, portals, windmills and pendulums, a coach that explains its putts, ghost replays, daily challenges, lessons and up to four players. Works offline, no ads.

title: Arcforge Darts Deluxe
bannerAlt: Arcforge Darts Deluxe: Aim. Flick. Check out
description: A premium 3D darts game: a flick-to-throw control, 501, Cricket, Around the Clock and Killer, eight computer levels, seven tournaments, a daily challenge, checkout coaching and Darts School.

title: Arcforge Snooker Deluxe
bannerAlt: Arcforge Snooker Deluxe: Snooker, 8-ball and 9-ball with real physics
description: A premium 3D cue-sports table: snooker (full-size and a short six-red game), 8-ball and 9-ball with true rules, spin and cushions modelled by a physics engine. Six computer opponents, a three-chapter campaign, 24 solved trick shots, drills, lessons, a daily challenge, Watch and Learn, trophies and statistics.

title: Arcforge Reversi Deluxe
bannerAlt: Arcforge Reversi Deluxe: Glossy 3D discs and a genuinely hard opponent
description: The classic game of flipping discs in real-time 3D: two-sided discs that turn over in a rolling wave, rich board materials, eight computer levels with a top level that solves the ending perfectly, lessons, verified puzzles, named openings, a daily challenge and full game review with an evaluation graph. Offline, no ads.

title: Arcforge Xiangqi Deluxe
bannerAlt: Arcforge Xiangqi Deluxe: Chinese chess in real-time 3D that teaches you to win
description: A real-time 3D Xiangqi board with carved men, eight computer levels, a coach that grades your moves, 14 lessons, a 90-puzzle campaign, a daily challenge, an opening trainer and full game review. Offline, no ads.

title: Arcforge Shogi Deluxe
bannerAlt: Arcforge Shogi Deluxe: Japanese chess in 3D with a coach and 190 mating puzzles
description: Real-time 3D shogi with wedge-shaped wooden pieces on a kaya board, eight computer levels, sixteen hands-on lessons, 190 checkmate puzzles with a daily challenge, a castle and opening trainer, a coach that rates your moves and a full game review. Offline, no ads.

title: Arcforge Checkers Deluxe
bannerAlt: Arcforge Checkers Deluxe: Four rule sets, real 3D, a strong engine
description: The complete draughts app: American Checkers, Russian, Brazilian and International Draughts played by their real rules on beautiful 3D boards, against a strong engine with eight levels. Learn with 22 interactive lessons, solve about 190 puzzles and a Daily Shot, explore openings with engine scores and review every game move by move. Offline, no ads, no account.

title: Arcforge Snakes Ladders Deluxe
bannerAlt: Arcforge Snakes Ladders Deluxe: The tabletop dice race
description: A premium 3D snakes and ladders table with tumbling dice, slithering snakes, charms, mystery squares, six computer personalities, a twelve-stop Journey, a daily race, foresight trials and an Almanac on the history of the game.

title: Hanoi Tower: Brass & Lacquer
bannerAlt: Hanoi Tower: Brass & Lacquer: the tower puzzle in 3D
description: The classic tower puzzle as a brass and lacquer object in 3D: 48 towers on three to five pegs, the Rail and Ring rules, 12 lessons on the mathematics, a daily tower, free build, exact Par for every puzzle and Auto Play that explains each move. Offline, no ads, no account.

title: Huarong Gate: Lacquer Generals
bannerAlt: Huarong Gate: a lacquered 3D sliding-block puzzle with painted generals
description: The classic Huarong Road escape puzzle as a lacquered rosewood tray with painted generals, drawn in real-time 3D. Twelve chapters of 240 graded puzzles with a par proved by exhaustive search, eight lessons, a daily puzzle, Endless mode, hints that explain and Auto Play that thinks aloud. Offline, no ads.

title: Kite Duel: Festival Sky Fight
bannerAlt: Kite Duel: two fighting kites cross their threads in a festival sky
description: A fighting-kite sim in six 3D festival skies. Real wind and gusts, a kite that is a real sail, a thread with tension, sag and wear, and crossings where angle, grit and the draw decide who is cut. Thirty bouts, eight lessons, a daily duel, a hangar of kites and threads, and Auto Play where a master explains each move. Offline, no ads.

title: Cornhole Circuit: 3D Bag Toss
bannerAlt: Cornhole Circuit: 3D Bag Toss: a bag-toss tournament from backyard to arena
description: A bag-toss tournament in real-time 3D: swipe to pitch at a real-size slanted board, climb a five-event circuit from a backyard cup to an arena final, play quick matches, lessons and a daily board, and watch Auto Play explain its moves.

title: Pocket Gridiron: QB Playbook
bannerAlt: Pocket Gridiron: QB Playbook: a 3D quarterback game about reading the defence
description: A quarterback game in real-time 3D: call plays from a 21-play playbook, read a defence that adapts to you, and throw with a bullet, standard or touch pass. A season, 44 challenges, a daily drive, a film room and Watch & Learn with a coach that explains every read. Offline, no ads.

title: Top Clash: Spin Battle Arena
bannerAlt: Top Clash: Spin Battle Arena: heritage tops battle in 3D stadiums
description: A spinning-top battle arena with real spin physics: wind the cord, aim and clash six heritage tops in three 3D stadiums, win eight-player cups, learn in eight lessons, build your own top in the garage and watch Auto Play explain every move.

title: Kendama Dojo: 3D Skill Toy
bannerAlt: Kendama Dojo: 3D Skill Toy: A 3D kendama with real string-and-ball physics
description: Lift the ball with a flick, slide a cup or the spike under it, and hold the catch. Thirty tricks in six belts, lessons, a timed Flow Run, a daily trick and Auto Play that explains its moves. A lifelike hand, lacquered ken and ball, three rooms.

title: Shinny Pond Hockey
bannerAlt: Shinny Pond Hockey: Real-time 3D pond hockey you flick with one thumb
description: Skate a frozen pond in real-time 3D: one thumb steers, a swipe shoots, and the puck banks off snow and boulders. One-on-one or two-on-two against five computer levels, a 24-stop circuit across eight ponds, 24 skill drills, a daily shot, lessons and Auto Play.
